title: Flat affine lci deformations lift over Artinian coefficient surjections
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $\Lambda$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with a specified residue-field isomorphism $\Lambda/\mathfrak m_\Lambda\cong k$. Let $A^\prime\twoheadrightarrow A$ be a surjective local $\Lambda$-algebra homomorphism between commutative Artinian local $\Lambda$-algebras, with specified residue-field identifications $A^\prime/\mathfrak m_{A^\prime}\cong k$ and $A/\mathfrak m_A\cong k$ as $\Lambda$-algebras, inducing the identity on $k$. Here a local ring has exactly one maximal ideal and an Artinian ring has the descending chain condition on ideals. Let $V=\operatorname{Spec}P$ be an affine $k$-scheme, where $P$ is a finitely generated $k$-algebra that is a local complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Let $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a flat scheme [def-weil-flat-morphism] with a specified $k$-isomorphism $\iota:Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}k\cong V$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist a flat affine $A^\prime$-scheme $Y^\prime$, a $k$-isomorphism $\iota^\prime:Y^\prime\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A^\prime}\operatorname{Spec}k\cong V$, and an $A$-isomorphism $\alpha:Y^\prime\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A^\prime}\operatorname{Spec}A\cong Y$ whose reduction to $k$ satisfies $\iota\circ\alpha_k=\iota^\prime$. No bound on the dimension of $V$ and no smoothness hypothesis on $V$ is imposed. The zero algebra and empty scheme are allowed.

source.place: Tag 0DZH (lemma-lci-unobstructed), scheme formulation via Tag 0DYX (lemma-affine), with example-schemes and section-general; formal-defos.tex, definition-CLambda specifies the coefficient identifications.

proof.text: Put $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak m_A$. By [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-noetherian-nilpotent], $A$ is Noetherian and $\mathfrak m^N=0$ for some $N\ge1$. Using the specified identification $A/\mathfrak m\cong k$, clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-base-change-nilpotent-thickening-idempotents] says that $Y_k\to Y$ is a thickening. Its source is isomorphic to the affine scheme $V$ by $\iota$. Therefore [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-affine-scheme] makes $Y$ affine. Choose $Y\cong\operatorname{Spec}Q$ over $\operatorname{Spec}A$.

source.place: Tag 0DYX, lemma-affine, proof, using more-morphisms.tex Tags 09ZU and 06AD and algebra.tex Tags 00KH and 00J8.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-iff-flat-affine], $Q$ is flat over $A$. By [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra], $Y_k\cong\operatorname{Spec}(Q\otimes_A k)$. The affine-spectrum correspondence [def-weil-affine-spectrum] applied to $\iota$ yields the specified $k$-algebra isomorphism $P\cong Q\otimes_A k$. The map $Q\otimes_A(A/\mathfrak m)\to Q/\mathfrak m Q$, $q\otimes\bar a\mapsto\overline{aq}$, has inverse $\bar q\mapsto q\otimes1$; the balancing relation makes these maps inverse ring maps. Thus $Q/\mathfrak m Q\cong P$ is finite type over $k$.

source.place: Tag 0DYX, lemma-affine, coordinate interpretation and example-rings; schemes.tex Tag 01I4.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-lift-nilpotent] to $A\to Q$ and $\mathfrak m$: step 1 supplies nilpotence and step 2 finite type modulo $\mathfrak m$. Hence $Q$ is of finite type over $A$. Since $A$ is Noetherian, [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-noetherian-finite-presentation] makes $Q$ finitely presented over $A$.

source.place: Tag 0DZH, lemma-lci-unobstructed, implicit finite-presentation check in its syntomicity assertion; algebra.tex Tag 00FP and the nilpotent finite-type lifting argument.

proof.text: Every prime $\mathfrak p$ of $A$ contains $\mathfrak m$: for $a\in\mathfrak m$ we have $a^N=0\in\mathfrak p$, hence $a\in\mathfrak p$. As $\mathfrak m$ is maximal, $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak m$ and $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=k$. Its fibre ring is $Q\otimes_A k\cong P$, which is lci by hypothesis. Together with flatness in step 2 and finite presentation in step 3, this verifies exactly the three conditions for syntomicity written in [lem-sfb-syntomic-algebra-surjection-lift].

source.place: Tag 00SL, definition-lci, applied over the Artinian local base, as in examples-defos.tex Tag 0DZH.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-syntomic-algebra-surjection-lift] with $R=A^\prime$, $R_0=A$, $B_0=Q$, and $I=\ker(A^\prime\to A)$. Surjectivity is a hypothesis and step 4 verifies syntomicity. It gives a syntomic $A^\prime$-algebra $Q^\prime$ and an $A$-algebra isomorphism $\beta:Q^\prime/IQ^\prime\cong Q$. Set $Y^\prime=\operatorname{Spec}Q^\prime$. The written definition of syntomic gives flatness of $Q^\prime$ over $A^\prime$, so [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-iff-flat-affine] gives the required flatness of this affine scheme.

source.place: Tag 0DZH, lemma-lci-unobstructed, final proof sentence invoking smoothing.tex Tag 07M8, proposition-lift-smooth (1).

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] and the quotient-tensor maps of step 2 with $I$ in place of $\mathfrak m$ to identify $Y^\prime\times_{A^\prime}A$ with $\operatorname{Spec}(Q^\prime/IQ^\prime)$. The inverse of $\operatorname{Spec}\beta$, followed by the chosen identification $\operatorname{Spec}Q\cong Y$, gives an $A$-isomorphism $\alpha:Y^\prime\times_{A^\prime}A\cong Y$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Define $\iota^\prime=\iota\circ\alpha_k$. The comparison $(Y^\prime\times_{A^\prime}A)\times_A k\cong Y^\prime\times_{A^\prime}k$ follows directly from the fibre-product universal property [def-pc-fibre-product]: the same compatible projections specify both cones and their inverse maps. Since $A^\prime\to A\to k$ is the specified residue map, this is the required special fibre. The equality $\iota\circ\alpha_k=\iota^\prime$ is its definition. If $P=0$, step 1 gives $Y=\varnothing$ (a thickening preserves the underlying space); taking $Y^\prime=\varnothing$ gives the same conclusion.
